task.title: Issues board GitHub grouping, repository default, work row
task.description: Plan slice 5 (R3, D5). apps/desktop/src/issues/model.ts: groupForRow without a GitHub Project groups by GitHub state (open, closed); the Closed lane is drawn only when filters.state is closed or all; GitHub Project grouping is unchanged. Remove the Flow stage filter (Filters.stage, IssueFilters control, readPreferences key, active-filter chips); stored preferences with a stage key are ignored. SOURCES gains repository: "Project repository" (use IssueListSource from src/integrations/issues-contract.ts, committed in T6; the backend lists /repos/{owner}/{repo}/issues of the project repo for source "repository"); default source becomes repository when nothing is stored; a stored source preference wins; the other sources stay selectable. Work row on each issue card and list row (reuse the look of apps/desktop/src/review/PrWorkRow.tsx from T8 where sensible, same fixed height) with two slots: Flow (issue.work stage != none: link "Flow · <stage label>" -> open-flow action; none: "Create Flow" -> prepare-flow; keep Resume preparation) and session (sessions whose sessionFlags(s).subject is kind issue with this repo+number via sameSubject, non-archived; "Session"/"<n> sessions" opens via the existing open-session action (it reuses the bound session); none: "Open in session"). The board needs the project sessions: pass state.sessions from App.tsx through IssuesView to IssuesBoard as a prop (default empty). Every action keeps visible text (T8 already made card buttons textual; keep that). Tests: model tests for grouping by state and hidden Closed lane, stage filter gone; IssuesBoard DOM tests: issues without Flow spread over Open/Closed, Flow stage shown as a link not a column, default source repository, stored preference wins, work row slots and labels, session slot counts sessions with matching subject. Run cd apps/desktop && bunx tsc --noEmit && bun test src (full suite; the App fixture in src/test is shared).

acceptance_criteria: AC6: Every action on a PR card, PR list row and Issue card has a visible text label (a DOM test asserts non-empty text content for each action control); "Fix review comments" is not shown in this stage (R7 part, spec AC15 part) [verify: exec `cd apps/desktop && bun test src/review src/issues`]

AC11: Issues board default grouping is by GitHub state (Open · Closed, Closed drawn only when the state filter includes closed issues); GitHub Project grouping is unchanged; the Flow stage filter is gone; issues without a Flow are spread over the GitHub columns (R3, spec AC12) [verify: exec `cd apps/desktop && bun test src/issues`]

AC12: Each Issue card has a work row with a Flow slot (link with stage, or "Create Flow") and a session slot (bound sessions found through `subject`, or "Open in session") [verify: exec `cd apps/desktop && bun test src/issues`]

AC13: The default Issues source is the project repository: `keryx issues list` with `source: "repository"` lists `/repos/{owner}/{repo}/issues` of the repository resolved from the project cwd and excludes pull requests; "Assigned to me" and the other sources stay selectable and a stored source preference wins (D5) [verify: exec `bun test src/integrations/issues-board.test.ts && cd apps/desktop && bun test src/issues`]
